definitions.explanation: Of or relating to a straight line, or to a relationship in which one quantity changes in direct proportion to another. Used in math, physics, and engineering.

examples.japanese: {線形|せんけい}{代数|だいすう}を{学|まな}ぶ。
このグラフは{線形|せんけい}{関係|かんけい}を{示|しめ}している。
examples.english: This graph shows a linear relationship.

examples.japanese: {線形|せんけい}モデルでは、{入力|にゅうりょく}と{出力|しゅつりょく}が{比例|ひれい}{関係|かんけい}にあると{仮定|かてい}する。
examples.english: In a linear model, we assume the input and output are in a proportional relationship.

notes:
Almost always used in technical or academic contexts. Pairs with の or appears as a noun-modifier.

COMPOUNDS:
- {線形|せんけい}{代数|だいすう}: linear algebra
- {線形|せんけい}{方程式|ほうていしき}: linear equation
- {線形|せんけい}{関数|かんすう}: linear function
- {線形|せんけい}{回帰|かいき}: linear regression
- {非線形|ひせんけい}: nonlinear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {直線|ちょくせん}: straight line — refers to the line itself, not the property
- {一次|いちじ}: first-order; first-degree — used in {一次|いちじ}{方程式|ほうていしき} (linear equation), overlapping in math with {線形|せんけい}
